NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 · Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map

MarsFlex layers NASA Mars data for a hyper-local view of Jezero Crater (Perseverance landing region) and plans scenario walks for a human explorer: terrain-aware routes, optional science stops, a time and metabolic budget, and traceable orbital/rover evidence for every number shown.
details:
MarsFlex layers NASA Mars data for a hyper-local view of Jezero Crater (Perseverance landing region) and plans scenario walks for a human explorer: terrain-aware routes, optional

Start from the whole planet (Globe, Viking MDIM 2.1) and descend to Jezero (3D relief drawn 2.2× for display only, or a top-down 2D map). Find the best site (terrain, oxygen and time margin, science value), plan the walk, check oxygen and suit time against a NASA reference suit with a turn-back point, see what the rover saw at each station, and walk the route with a suit-style HUD.
